purpose: Test the unchanged seven 005B realised-movement hypotheses on the disjoint actual mapped 2026 SIG universe after the historical ordering correction survived post-hoc falsification.

accepted_group_rules: active/passive size conservation within 1e-8 relative tolerance
reconstruction.economic_rows: passive OrderFilled rows only; preserve multi-maker passive fills
hard_block_gate: 100% distinct tx_hash values map to non-null archival block_number
100% distinct mapped blocks map to non-null block timestamp
stored DATA-003 timestamp equals archival block timestamp for every economic row
no duplicate (block_number, log_index) within the retained economic fill population

frozen_features.price_change_30: p_yes - first_value(p_yes) over prior 30 seconds within condition
frozen_features.trade_count_30: count of economic fills over prior 30 seconds within condition
frozen_features.realised_vol_5: sqrt(sum(one_trade_change^2)) over prior 5 seconds within condition
frozen_features.absolute_return_5: abs(p_yes - first_value(p_yes)) over prior 5 seconds within condition
frozen_features.absolute_return_15: abs(p_yes - first_value(p_yes)) over prior 15 seconds within condition
frozen_features.absolute_return_30: abs(p_yes - first_value(p_yes)) over prior 30 seconds within condition
frozen_features.absolute_return_60: abs(p_yes - first_value(p_yes)) over prior 60 seconds within condition
frozen_features.absolute_return_120: abs(p_yes - first_value(p_yes)) over prior 120 seconds within condition
frozen_features.absolute_return_300: abs(p_yes - first_value(p_yes)) over prior 300 seconds within condition
frozen_features.absolute_return_900: abs(p_yes - first_value(p_yes)) over prior 900 seconds within condition
frozen_features.recent_max_move_900: max(abs(one_trade_change)) over prior 900 seconds within condition
frozen_features.distance_recent_low_300: p_yes - min(p_yes) over prior 300 seconds within condition

frozen_target_definition: For each horizon h in {1,5,15,30,60,120,300}, sqrt(sum(one_trade_change^2)) over strictly following economic fills within h seconds in the same condition; target is null when no following fill exists in-window.

historical_fit.source: five corrected 005B family matrices only; DATA-003 never enters fitting
historical_fit.eligibility: timestamp < dev_end_timestamp - 300; target and corresponding clock_label_end non-null; clock_label_end < dev_end_timestamp
historical_fit.refit_policy: fit each original DEV-selected model once on the corrected historical TRAIN+DEV sample for that target

baselines.persistence: constant historical corrected TRAIN+DEV mean of the target
baselines.own_recent_price: historical corrected TRAIN+DEV linear regression on price_change_30
baselines.current_absolute_movement: historical corrected TRAIN+DEV linear regression on absolute_return_30
baselines.recent_activity: historical corrected TRAIN+DEV linear regression on trade_count_30

evaluation.test_set: all eligible DATA-003 economic fills; evaluation-only; no split/tuning

per_horizon: model aggregate MAE is strictly lower than all four frozen baseline MAEs
condition-cluster bootstrap lower 2.5% bound versus persistence is strictly greater than zero
confirmation_rule.full_movement_transfer: all seven horizons satisfy both per-horizon conditions
confirmation_rule.partial_result_policy: report exact passing/failing horizons; do not replace, tune, subset or rescue failures
